t_advice_summary_textbox.text: to choose the gnome that will bring you to the forest where you will harvest the most mushrooms

vb_textbox.text: My advice is to pay attention to the coloured gnomes that give you the most but beware they change over time. e.g the brown gnome will give you the most mushrooms for a certain period of time. Once it stops then change colours, unfortunately it is not a consistent pattern and it can be quite pot luck. Try to be quick on the keys also as it will flag as 'too slow'
